title: Framework master governance and Actions defaults lack external enforcement
title_de: Framework-master-Governance und Actions-Defaults besitzen keine externe Durchsetzung
affected_symbols: current-head PR, review, and required-check enforcement
observed_behavior: For Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework at the reviewed PR #27 head 2f635be02ede802024ec9e0ce2ed41e3030cbff2, read-only GitHub API evidence shows classic master protection returns HTTP 404 Branch not protected; the master branch reports protected=false with no required checks; repository rulesets and effective master rules are empty; Actions default_workflow_permissions is write; and one direct collaborator has admin, maintain, and push capabilities. The current PR source is safer than that default: its PR CodeQL workflow is read-only, exact-head, credentialless, and non-uploading, while its trusted uploader is non-PR and scopes its added capability to security-events.
observed_behavior_de: Für Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework beim geprüften PR-#27-Head 2f635be02ede802024ec9e0ce2ed41e3030cbff2 zeigt schreibgeschützte GitHub-API-Evidence: Der klassische master-Schutz liefert HTTP 404 Branch not protected; der master-Branch meldet protected=false ohne Required Checks; Repository-Rulesets und effektive master-Regeln sind leer; Actions default_workflow_permissions ist write; und ein direkter Collaborator besitzt admin-, maintain- und push-Fähigkeiten. Der aktuelle PR-Source ist sicherer als dieser Default: Sein PR-CodeQL-Workflow ist read-only, exact-head, credentialless und non-uploading, während sein vertrauenswürdiger Uploader non-PR ist und seine zusätzliche Fähigkeit auf security-events begrenzt.
expected_behavior: A no-bypass GitHub governance control independently enforces master protection or rules, current-head pull-request/review/required-check requirements, and least-privilege Actions defaults. Source-controlled PR workflow declarations remain defense in depth rather than the sole mechanism protecting future master and workflow changes.
expected_behavior_de: Ein No-bypass-GitHub-Governance-Control erzwingt unabhängig master-Schutz oder Regeln, current-head Pull-Request-/Review-/Required-Check-Anforderungen und Least-Privilege-Actions-Defaults. Source-kontrollierte PR-Workflow-Deklarationen bleiben Defense in Depth statt des einzigen Mechanismus zum Schutz künftiger master- und Workflow-Änderungen.
impact: The current Framework master-integration prerequisites are not externally enforceable: a privileged collaborator or compromised privileged credential could change master or its adjudicating workflow without an evidenced independent PR, review, or current-head check. The attack-path analysis does not classify this as a reportable security vulnerability because the only demonstrated source already has privileged repository-write authority and no lower-privilege escalation is proven. It is nevertheless a validated GitHub-governance and release-control blocker; no unauthenticated RCE, PR write token, secret exposure, Parent gitlink change, or MRTS change is claimed.
impact_de: Die aktuellen Framework-master-Integrationsvoraussetzungen sind nicht extern durchsetzbar: Ein privilegierter Collaborator oder ein kompromittiertes privilegiertes Credential könnte master oder seinen entscheidenden Workflow ohne nachgewiesenen unabhängigen PR-, Review- oder current-head-Check ändern. Die Attack-Path-Analyse klassifiziert dies nicht als reportable Security-Vulnerability, weil die einzige nachgewiesene Quelle bereits privilegierte Repository-Write-Autorität besitzt und keine Lower-Privilege-Eskalation bewiesen ist. Es bleibt dennoch ein validierter GitHub-Governance- und Release-Control-Blocker; es werden keine unauthentifizierte RCE, kein PR-Write-Token, keine Secret-Exposition, keine Parent-Gitlink-Änderung und keine MRTS-Änderung behauptet.
preconditions: The GitHub repository Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework remains accessible to the authorized read-only GitHub CLI account.
The current master control-plane state remains the one returned by the retained read-only API receipt.
A malicious privileged collaborator or a compromised privileged credential acts; no lower-privileged external or fork-PR attacker path is evidenced.

evidence.command: rtk gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/branches/master/protection; rtk gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/branches/master; rtk gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/rulesets; rtk gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/rules/branches/master; rtk gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/actions/permissions/workflow; rtk gh api repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-test-Framework/collaborators?affiliation=direct

root_cause: Framework PR workflow YAML explicitly constrains the current source, but GitHub repository configuration does not independently require future master/workflow changes to preserve those declarations. The absence of master protection/effective rules and the write Actions default are external control-plane facts, distinct from the currently safe PR source. The final security attack-path policy ignores the candidate because the demonstrated attacker already has repository-write authority; this does not restore the missing governance control.
root_cause_de: Framework-PR-Workflow-YAML begrenzt den aktuellen Source explizit, aber die GitHub-Repository-Konfiguration verlangt nicht unabhängig, dass künftige master-/Workflow-Änderungen diese Deklarationen bewahren. Das Fehlen von master-Schutz/effektiven Regeln und der write-Actions-Default sind externe Control-Plane-Fakten und vom aktuell sicheren PR-Source verschieden. Die finale Security-Attack-Path-Policy ignoriert den Kandidaten, weil der nachgewiesene Angreifer bereits Repository-Write-Autorität hat; dadurch wird das fehlende Governance-Control nicht wiederhergestellt.
proposed_remediation: Only an authorized GitHub repository owner or administrator may decide and apply the Framework configuration. Establish no-bypass master protection or rules, require current-head pull-request/review/required-check enforcement, and set least-privilege default Actions workflow permissions. Retain current explicit PR workflow permissions as defense in depth. Reread the same endpoints and then repeat exact-head PR #27 delivery verification. Do not direct-push master, use an admin bypass, weaken a check, or infer risk acceptance from a merge request.
proposed_remediation_de: Nur ein autorisierter GitHub-Repository-Owner oder Administrator darf die Framework-Konfiguration entscheiden und anwenden. No-bypass master-Schutz oder Regeln herstellen, current-head Pull-Request-/Review-/Required-Check-Durchsetzung verlangen und Least-Privilege-Default-Actions-Workflow-Berechtigungen setzen. Die aktuellen expliziten PR-Workflow-Berechtigungen als Defense in Depth beibehalten. Dieselben Endpoints erneut lesen und danach die Exact-Head-PR-#27-Delivery-Verifikation wiederholen. Keinen direkten master-Push, keinen Admin-Bypass und keine Check-Abschwächung verwenden und Risikoakzeptanz nicht aus einer Merge-Anfrage ableiten.
acceptance_criteria: A post-change read-only GitHub receipt proves no-bypass master protection or effective rules are present.
The configured rule requires the intended current-head pull-request, review, and required-check controls without a direct-push or administrator bypass.
The Actions permissions endpoint reports a least-privilege default rather than default_workflow_permissions=write.
PR #27 is re-read at its exact current head and independently satisfies all delivery checks, reviews, thread, ruleset, and merge-method prerequisites.
No Parent source or gitlink, MRTS content or gitlink, Framework product source, security control, or SonarCloud result is weakened as a workaround.
validation_plan: Repeat every command in reproduction and retain a new hash-addressed configuration readback.
Read the effective master rule, required-check/current-head settings, bypass actors, and Actions default before enabling PR delivery.
Re-run the final exact-head PR #27 local and GitHub delivery preflight after any authorized configuration change.
Confirm the existing read-only PR CodeQL workflow and trusted non-PR uploader remain valid legitimate controls.
legitimate_control_tests: The PR CodeQL workflow remains pull_request-scoped, contents: read, exact-head, credentialless, non-submodule, and non-uploading.
The trusted CodeQL workflow remains non-PR and restricts its added write capability to security-events.
The configured governance control permits a compliant current-head PR to proceed without a bypass.
dependencies: An explicit current-user decision authorizing the GitHub configuration change, or explicit acceptance of the precise residual governance risk.
GitHub repository-owner or administrator capability to apply and reread the configuration.
blocked_by: The current task has no explicit authority to change GitHub master protection, rulesets, bypass settings, or Actions-default configuration.
The retained API receipt proves the prerequisite controls are absent at the reviewed state.
The current user's 2026-07-26 accepted-risk decision archives rather than remediates the remaining direct-master/check-bypass risk.

Current PR workflow controls remain valid but are not an external no-bypass guarantee. This is an accepted-risk archive disposition, not a technical closure; restore and revalidate the record before production, publication, or release use.
residual_risk_de: Der aktuelle Nutzer akzeptierte diesen Record am 2026-07-26 für die lokale Archivierung. Bis eine autorisierte Konfigurationsentscheidung und ein Endpoint-Readback erfolgen, kann ein privilegierter Collaborator oder ein kompromittiertes privilegiertes Credential die unabhängig erzwungene master-Review-/current-head-Check-Grenze für sichere Integration umgehen. Die aktuellen PR-Workflow-Controls bleiben gültig, sind aber keine externe No-bypass-Garantie. Dies ist eine Accepted-Risk-Archiv-Disposition, kein technischer Abschluss; vor Produktion, Veröffentlichung oder Release muss der Record wiederhergestellt und neu validiert werden.

history.detail: Read-only API evidence recorded no classic master protection, protected=false, no repository/effective rules, a write Actions default, and a direct collaborator with admin, maintain, and push capabilities.

CAND-PR27-GITHUB-GOVERNANCE-001 was technically validated but final security policy ignored it as privileged-only with no proven lower-privilege escalation. The independently required master-integration governance control remains blocked pending an authorized configuration decision or explicit risk acceptance.

The current user explicitly accepted this exact residual risk for local archive disposition. No GitHub rule, protection, bypass, or Actions-default configuration changed and no technical closure is claimed.
